interpretation: The production queue/lease one-shot lane can execute a ResearchGoal through Local LLM semantic action selection, a whitelisted deterministic research tool, evidence readback, canonical COMPLETE normalization, durable AgentResult storage, model unload and process exit.
The smoke validates orchestration and evidence plumbing only; it does not validate profitability of the MA5 strategy.
Completed results are idempotently reusable by the verifier without starting the Local LLM again.
operatingBoundary: Production Local LLM research remains one-shot and non-polling.
Daytime execution requires the explicit development test override.
Scheduled automatic research must remain after-hours only.
Ollama keep_alive remains 0 for autonomous research calls.
No broker or order action is allowed in the autonomous research lane.
nextGate: Add a bounded deterministic moving-average sweep capability so a ResearchGoal can ask the agent to search periods 5 through 120, rank Discovery evidence, freeze one candidate, evaluate it on chronological Validation, and return BEST or NO_GO without manually prescribing each period.
